payload.claim: Thickening the high-index layers relative to low-index layers (non-quarter-wave) can broaden the stopband to cover the full visible range at 45 degrees.

predictions.controlled_conditions: Same layer count, material order, substrate, 45-degree unpolarized light.
predictions.reason: Increasing high-index optical thickness may shift and broaden the stopband edges to better encompass the 450-650 nm range, compensating for angular narrowing.
